dialogue.t: "...They say that Omikami's envoy had three eyes: one for the 'soul,' one a 'mirror,' and the last the 'truth'..."
"...From the depths it arose, from the <color=#00E1FFFF>south</color>, o'er the <color=#00E1FFFF>north</color>, and all about the <color=#00E1FFFF>western</color> mound..."
"...The three eyes shone mercilessly to ward off the dragon's heir..."
Paimon... knows all these words... but none of them mean anything when strung together.
It doesn't look like there are any clues around here either, so why don't we try using <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>?
